context_requirements: Active p38 MAPK signaling (basal or stimulus-induced) for inhibitor to reduce phosphorylation
Inflammatory or stress signaling that drives p38-dependent transcription
For CYP1A1 induction: aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) expression and ligand availability
falsifiers: No decrease in p38-dependent transcripts such as DUSP1, FOS, JUN, or MAPKAPK2 at 6 h
No change in inflammatory gene expression (CXCL2, IL1B, PTGS2) at 6 h
No antiproliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h
Strong induction of CYP1A1 in all lines at 6 h (would suggest AhR activation rather than p38 inhibition)

evidence.supports: p38 MAPK inhibitor FR-167653 inhibits ATF-2 phosphorylation and reduces TNF-alpha, CTGF, and apoptosis in lung fibrosis
p38 MAPK inhibitor SB202190 reduces hippocampal apoptosis and improves memory in vascular dementia model
p38 MAPK inhibitor BIRB796 enhances apoptosis and antitumor effects in cervical cancer
p38 MAPK inhibitor SB203580 reduces oxidative stress and apoptosis in cisplatin nephrotoxicity
p38 MAPK inhibitor SB203580 induces CYP1A1 via AhR activation in hepatoma cells
